ai_summary: ByteDance effect-SDK face stack. Three non-TFLite '.model' bundles (smash-face base detector, extra landmark/eye model, age attribute model) feed FaceDetectTaskTT and FaceAttributesTask inside libeffect.so; the ByteNN runtime (libbytenn.so + JNI libbytennwrapper.so, pitaya stones libByteAINN/libByteAIDT) provides app-level inference. Container decoded: 16-byte file id, size/name/record-count header, then per record a name, a 32-byte per-file key, a 32-byte blob whose u32@+4 is the descriptor-block length ((len-4)%16==0), and a [graph descriptor][plaintext weights] payload. The descriptor field layout (op enum, tensor ids, quantisation) is only known to the stripped libeffect.so, so tensor extraction is still blocked; the 'mean' record is fully decoded as [u32 7620][1905 fp32][8 zero] and holds anchor/prior geometry, not normalisation means.

features.name: Video-frame interface (VESDK GL texture -> libeffect -> VEFaceDetectInfo)
pipeline: camera SurfaceTexture.updateTexImage on the GL thread; frame rendered into FBO LJJJJJ (texture LJJJJJL, GL_TEXTURE_2D/RGBA8, 270*h/480 x h)
BEFEffectNative.processFrame(handle, inTextureId, outTextureId, width, height, System.nanoTime()/1e9)
nativeProcessFrame: set_width_height(handle,w,h) then process_texture(handle,inTex,outTex,ts); loading timeout argument forced to 0
effect graph converts the texture to a packed CPU image (RGB888 3ch or RGBA8888 4ch); YUV and gray are rejected by FaceDetectTaskTT
FS_DoPredict(handle, data, channels<=3, ..., stride=3*w, flags, result*)
smash ModelPackage resolves submodels by name search (base120, base120det, pout, eyecls, partface, image, slowimage, mean; extra/iris in the second file)

detector preprocessing: format validation 0x68fc4c, then letterbox planner 0x9cf6d8/0x9cf7ac (short side scaled to the net input, other side aligned, scale cached at +0x34/+0x38); numeric extent unknown; the two u8->float32 loops at 0x9a0100 and 0x9e4fb0 belong to GAN nets (FUN_0099f8b0 'up_0_bright_high', FUN_009e4a90 'LaughGanRet does not init.')
espresso::Thrustor per submodel: CreateNet(0x697ce8) -> SetInput(0x9a017c) -> Inference(0x697a90/0x9e50b8) -> Extract(0x697a60)/getOutput(0x69e2d4); setThreads(4)
postprocess: dequantise + index permute (0x697ab4-0x697b88, table 0x12a2bf0), 19/47-class threshold helper (0x69f740-0x69f858)

algorithm_result_face_st -> FaceDetect/FaceExtInfo -> VEFaceDetectInfo{PVJ[]}: rect, score, 106 points, 106 visibility, yaw/pitch/roll, eyeDistance, faceID, action, trackCount, PVI(eyes 22+22, brows 13+13, lips 64, iris 20+20)
consumers: GL overlay X.EHf/X.EHg, rect extraction La.LIZ, attribute callback X.EHr.onResult, effect nodes FaceReshape_V2/FaceDistortion (landmark pos 23/19/13/105)
effect writes the result into the output texture (or 256x256 preview) and the view draws it to the surface; recording is VESDK-native
features.notes: Frame path confirmed end to end: NaviGLSurfaceView.onDrawFrame passes (inTextureId, outTextureId, width, height, System.nanoTime()/1e9) into nativeProcessFrame, whose x3/x4 are forwarded by register-shuttle thunks (0xaf58d4 / 0xa9f91c) as args 2-3 of bef_effect_process_texture; the log format at .rodata 0xc9ef2c fixes the loading-timeout and timestamp arguments. Textures are GL_TEXTURE_2D/RGBA8 with per-texture FBOs (C36620EXe.LIZJ); rotation and camera facing are one-shot setters. The DNNs receive a packed CPU RGB(A) buffer via FS_DoPredict (channels <= 3, YUV/gray rejected). FS_DoPredict also holds the adaptive frame-skip logic (2, then 4, then interval/3 while no face is found) and caches the input extent at [handle+0x17c]/[handle+0x178]. The detector's own resize/normalisation stays unknown; the two u8->f32 loops in libeffect belong to GAN modules. See PIPELINE.md sections 3, 5, 8 and evidence/frame_pipeline_native.md.

models.format: ByteDance 'smashed face' bundle (16-B id, size/name/record-count header, 9 records: detect, base120, base120det, pout, eyecls, partface, image, slowimage, mean; proprietary graph payload; NOT TFLite, NOT bytenn 'BM')

inputs: image / slowimage: raw tensor blob (exact shape unknown; 120 inferred from record name base120)
io.preprocessing: no normalisation constants in the container: the 'mean' record is [u32 7620][1905 float32][8 zero] holding a monotone anchor/prior table (30.03/73.78, 30.07/86.69, 30.16/99.6 ...); preprocessing must come from libeffect.so (unknown)
io.notes: payload = [descriptor block of size blob2+4, high entropy 7.7-8.0][weight data, entropy 5.0-7.7]; descriptor tails contain int16 op/tensor arrays and u32 offsets just below the block size

reimplementation.limitations: Only the .model container and the descriptor-block split are decoded (verified). The descriptor field layout is understood exclusively by the stripped 19 MB libeffect.so smash-face loader (FS_AddExtraModelFromBuf), so neither weights nor layer topology were extracted; bytenn's XOR+inv_sbox model cipher was tested and does not apply to these payloads. JAX apply() is a shape-compatible placeholder for the documented I/O (1x3x120x120 -> pout/box).

data_pipelines.name: Camera frame -> face detection/landmarks -> effect render (AR/Navi preview)

sources_triggers.gating: effect package requirement.faceDetect (assets/ttlive_reshape_composer distortion_test/content.json true; ttlive_Live_Beauty_12 beauty.json false); ShouldGenerateTask + face_detect_interval/skip_frame config keys
sources_triggers.lifecycle: onSurfaceCreated: createHandle/initResourceFinder(270,480,'android')/setOrientation 0/setFrameOrientation 0/setCameraPosition true; teardown deletes 5 FBOs+5 textures

transport.kind: GL_TEXTURE_2D (3553), internal format GL_RGBA (6408), type GL_UNSIGNED_BYTE (5121), GL_LINEAR, one FBO per texture
transport.timestamp: System.nanoTime()/1.0E9 seconds (monotonic), not the SurfaceTexture timestamp
transport.rotation_facing: one-shot setters: setOrientation/0, setFrameOrientation/0, setCameraPosition(true) -> native bef_effect_set_camera_device_position(handle, !z) (0x2ead0c)
transport.internal_cpu_format: packed RGB888 (type 3, 3ch, stride 3*w) or RGBA8888 (types 0-2, 4ch, stride 4*w); types 4 (gray) and 5 (YUV) rejected
transport.thread: GL render thread, one synchronous call per frame; espresso::Thrustor::setThreads(4)

preprocessing.order: u8 HWC packed image -> (resize/crop, unknown) -> (normalisation, unknown) -> model input
preprocessing.confirmed: packed 1 byte/channel, no channel swap in the copy loop; aspect-preserving letterbox planner 0x9cf6d8 (portrait) / 0x9cf7ac (landscape): scale = net short side / short extent, other side rounded to the nearest multiple of the alignment field, scale cached at +0x34/+0x38 for back-mapping; face-box crop helpers GetSquareBox/expand box (0x6a2bec/0x6a2aa8)
preprocessing.unknown: numeric net input extent + alignment (read at runtime from model info net[+8]/net[+0xc]); detector u8->f32 normalisation (no such loop in 0x68bc04/0x9cf2d4/0x9cf6d8/0x9cf7ac)
preprocessing.negative_result: the two u8->f32 loops found next to Thrustor::SetInput/Inference belong to GAN nets: 0x9a0100 in FUN_0099f8b0 (layer name 'up_0_bright_high', f = u8/128 - 1), 0x9e4fb0 in FUN_009e4a90 ('LaughGanRet does not init.', f = (u8/255 - mean)/scale). Not the face detector.

model_invocation.submodel_lookup: name search inside the buffer (base120 0x696268, base120det 0x696334, pout 0x6963d0, iris 0x69641c, eyecls 0x696470, partface 0x696544, extra 0x6964d4, slowimage 0x6965d8, mean 0x68a6a8)
model_invocation.calls: CreateNet 0x697ce8, SetInput 0x9a017c, Inference 0x697a90/0x9e50b8, Extract 0x697a60, getOutput 0x69e2d4, ReInferShape 0x6a5238, SkipLayer 0x696bb0, setThreads(4) 0x9b2588

postprocessing.dequant_permute: 0x697ab4-0x697b88: element *= scale, store via int32 index table at .rodata 0x12a2bf0
postprocessing.classify: 0x69f740-0x69f858: argmax over 19 or 47 classes, thresholds 0.5 / 0.125, cached in [obj+0x70]
postprocessing.java_bridge: FaceDetectInfo -> VEFaceDetectInfo.covert -> VEFaceDetectInfo{PVJ[]}; PVJ = rect, score, PointF[106], float[106] visibility, yaw, pitch, roll, eyeDistance, faceID, action, trackCount, PVI
